sections.title: Fats
sections.narration: 6.1 grams of fat. Omega 3 is 300 milligrams, supporting a more useful fat profile. Polyunsaturated fat is 3.3 grams, helping with cell structure and healthy signalling, and it is still a strong secondary mark. For grains, fat usually matters less than carbs.

sections.title: Carbs
sections.narration: 64.2 grams of carbs. Fibre is 7 grams, helping with digestion and steadier meals. Sugar is 4 grams, making sugar control harder, so that's a real downside for grains. For grains, carb quality matters most.
